scenario_summary: Customer is disputing an unrecognized $76 charge from two days ago and requesting a potential refund.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Meredith Hughes and I'm 34. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?

Hello Meredith, I understand how concerning it is to see an unrecognized charge. I would be happy to investigate this for you. To get started, could you please provide your account number and the email address associated with your profile for verification?
Sure, my account number is 88492011 and my email is m.hughes@email.com.
Thank you. For security purposes, I have sent a one-time verification code to your registered mobile number ending in -44. Could you please provide that code?
Verification successful, thank you. I am looking at the transaction from two days ago for $76.00 labeled 'Global Tech Solutions'. Does that merchant name sound familiar to you at all?
No, that doesn't sound familiar. I haven't purchased anything from a 'Global Tech' company.

I appreciate you confirming that. Per our Transaction Dispute Policy, I have initiated a formal dispute for this unauthorized charge. I have also placed a temporary block on your card to prevent further unauthorized activity. The $76.00 has been provisionally credited back to your account while the investigation is underway. You will receive an email confirmation with the case reference number shortly.

resolution_summary: The agent verified the customer's identity, confirmed the unrecognized merchant, initiated a formal dispute, placed a security block on the card, and issued a provisional credit.
